title: The Rich Young Man
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Matthew 19:16-22: a young man asks what good thing gives eternal life, says he has kept the commandments, Jesus tells him to sell his possessions, give to the poor and follow him, and he goes away sad because he has great wealth; lessons: put God first, share.

floor.prerequisite: Knows ways of helping the needy.
floor.question: Name one way to help a needy person.

representations: a scale: wealth on one side, following Jesus on the other
steps: The young man asks about eternal life.
Sell, give to the poor, follow me.
contexts: giving clothes you no longer wear

board.do: Draw a scale with "wealth" and "follow Jesus".

board.say: Why did the young man go away sad?

board.do: Wait for the child to say he had great wealth.

listen_for: He sold everything and followed Jesus
misconceptions.ask: What did the young man do when Jesus told him to sell his things?

listen_for: That it is wrong to own anything
misconceptions.ask: What was Jesus showing the young man?
misconceptions.repair: Ask whether Jesus told everyone to sell everything.

listen_for: How he could get more money
misconceptions.ask: What did the young man ask Jesus?
The young man said he had kept the commandments. What did Jesus then ask of him (Matthew 19:21)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 19:20-21: "What do I still lack?" Jesus showed him what held his heart.

checks.question: What did the young man do after Jesus spoke?
What did Jesus show him?
checks.answer: His wealth held his heart; put God first
